knowledgeBase.title: Company knowledge base
knowledgeBase.desc: Answers from your company documents with sources; says so when the documents don't cover it.

suggestions.s1: How many days of annual leave do I get this year? What happens to unused days?
suggestions.s2: What is the hotel cap for business trips?
suggestions.s3: WARP can't reach the company intranet. What should I do?

cloudflareDocs.title: Cloudflare docs expert
cloudflareDocs.desc: Ask about Cloudflare products and architecture; it reads the official docs and answers with links to the source pages.

suggestions.s1: How do Workers and Pages differ? Which should a new project use?
suggestions.s2: How do I replace our corporate VPN with Zero Trust?
suggestions.s3: When should I use Durable Objects, KV or D1?
suggestions.s4: Which costs can AI Gateway save me?

threatIntel.title: Threat intel analyst
threatIntel.desc: Dispatches several analysts in parallel against live Cloudflare Radar data and writes a sourced threat briefing for Taiwan.

suggestions.s1: Who is attacking Taiwan? What changed since last week?
suggestions.s2: Any recent outages or BGP hijacks affecting Taiwan?
suggestions.s3: How much of Taiwan's traffic is bots? Which AI crawlers are most active?
suggestions.s4: Which industries in Taiwan are attacked most? What should retailers watch out for?
suggestions.s5: Show me the global rank of example.com.tw

kb.retentionNotice: Questions and uploaded document content are recorded in Cloudflare traces and kept for 7 days. Turn on "Don't record content" to opt out.
